whyMatters.en: Reading shoegaze/dream-pop band; Souvlaki (1993) fixed gentle vocals inside thick guitar fog as the softer Creation-era pole opposite MBV’s abrasion.
whyMatters.zh: 雷丁 shoegaze/dream-pop；Souvlaki（1993）把轻人声放进厚吉他雾，作为 Creation 时期相对 MBV 摩擦感的柔软一极。

shortBio.en: Neil Halstead / Rachel Goswell shoegaze; Alison is the Souvlaki entry.
shortBio.zh: Neil Halstead / Rachel Goswell 的 shoegaze；Alison 是 Souvlaki 入口。

body.en:
Formed 1989. Just for a Day and Souvlaki (with some Brian Eno input) use delay/reverb stacks, whispered dual vocals, and mid-tempo drums rather than noise assault.

Alison (1993) is the listed track. 2010s reunion albums confirmed a lasting template for dream-pop revival bands citing UK shoegaze.
body.zh:
1989 年组建。Just for a Day 与 Souvlaki（含部分 Brian Eno 参与）用延时/混响堆叠、低语双人声与中速鼓，而非噪声突击。

Alison（1993）是列出曲目。2010 年代重组专辑坐实了英国 shoegaze 被 dream-pop 复兴乐队持续引用的模板。
